article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- — Asjon Anderson's 20 points helped Alabama State defeat UAB 77-74 on Tuesday night. Anderson also contributed seven assists and four steals for the Hornets (1-1). Micah Simpsom scored 18 points, going 6 of 14 (6 for 11 from 3-point range). Tyler Byrd had eight points and finished 3 of 5 from the field. Chance Westry led the way for the Blazers (1-2) with 25 points. KyeRon Lindsay added 14 points for UAB. Ahmad Robinson also put up 12 points and four assists. Alabama State went into the half ahead of UAB 36-35. Simpsom scored 12 points in the half. Anderson scored 16 points down the stretch in the second half to help lead Alabama State to a three-point victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
